title: M5 Executor Selection and Capability Matching Authority Plan

selection_architecture.semantic_selection_authority: LLM / User / Upstream caller explicitly requests target executor or provides required capability constraints
selection_architecture.mechanical_resolution_authority: Core ExecutorRegistry and Dispatcher perform deterministic matching against registered adapters

cardinality_rules.zero_match: Returns EXECUTOR_NOT_FOUND error; fails closed; no fallback
cardinality_rules.one_match: Deterministically selects the unique matching adapter
cardinality_rules.multiple_matches_no_explicit_target: Returns NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE with candidate list; fails closed; no heuristic guessing

capability_matching.validation_model: Required capabilities in ExecutionPackage are checked against advertised ExecutorCapabilities
capability_matching.mode_matching: Exact match required on execution_mode, isolation_mode, and role_support
capability_matching.silent_downgrade: FORBIDDEN (e.g. if async requested but only sync supported, dispatch is rejected with CAPABILITY_MISMATCH)
capability_matching.timeout_matching: Requested timeout must be <= adapter max_timeout_seconds if set
